data.one_liner: An infinite scrolling PageView widget with custom indicator support for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a page view widget that supports infinite swiping and custom indicators. It allows developers to display pages in a continuous loop and design custom pagination indicators.
use_when: You need an infinite scrolling PageView for carousels or banners.
You want to implement a custom page indicator alongside your scrollable pages.
avoid_when: You need a standard finite PageView without infinite loop capabilities.
You require complex state management solutions built directly into the package.
strengths: Supports sound null safety and Flutter 3
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples provided in the README
